newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-CAMBRIDGE GROUP EYES LIETUVA HOTEL - MINISTER.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-CAMBRIDGE GROUP EYES LIETUVA HOTEL - MINISTER.

text.p: Lithuania's European Affairs Minister Laima Andrikiene said on Friday that a company called the Cambridge Group was eyeing the Lietuva Hotel, which has been slated for privatisation.
The group won a bid to privatise the hotel in 1993 but the former government later pulled the plug on the deal.
She gave no details about where Cambridge Group is based.
"We have invited the Cambridge Group to continue negotiations...and in April they will be here," Andrikiene told a news conference.
She added that the Lietuva Hotel would be sold through the process of direct negotiations.
